note: Written by living/tools/blender/buildings.py --table (gen_buildings.sh). models: every generated model, its file under envs/, form, footprint (width along the front, depth front to back, overhangs, steps and yards included), height above the floor, foundation depth below it, corner (the side of a corner building's second street front in the model's frame: 1 = +X, -1 = -X), triangles, and what it hides at eye height: eye_solid, the share of the footprint solid between 1.2 and 1.8 m, and eye_cells, per 0.5 m square of the footprint the share of the view through it blocked in that band (columns, then runs of a count and a level from a = none to k = all, row-major from the front row, column 0 at the model's -X; buildings.py eye_cells). kinds: the envelope of every model of a kind.
